title: War of the Vicuñas and Basques
summary: The English Wikipedia article "War of the Vicuñas and Basques", at revision 1370750251, opens: "The War of the Vicuñas and Basques, or sometimes just Vicuña War, was an armed conflict in Charcas Province, present-day Bolivia, that lasted between June 1622 and March 1625, fought between Basques and "Vicuñas"." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4867844, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between Basques and other Spaniards in 17th century Bolivia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (named for this item in data/imports/wikidata-seeds.json): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
